answer.explanation: In the 16:59:45-17:09:45Z window, all four functions logged only normal REPORT lines and two INIT_START cold starts (17:06:32 Uploader, 17:08:06 Compression). There were no error, exception, AccessDenied, timeout or out-of-memory lines, and no active CloudWatch alarms. Per-function behaviour matched the pre-window baseline since 2026-10-17 14:00: CrudApi about 25-60 ms at 256 MB, Uploader about 80-170 ms at 256 MB, Thumbnailer about 100 ms at 1024 MB, and Compression about 540 ms at 1024 MB with max memory around 100-120 MB. Compression's 1024 MB allocation is over-provisioned relative to its usage, but that is stable and not a change within the window, so it is not treated as an anomaly here.
